prompt:
Redesign the THREE uploaded real Android ACCA-NG app screenshots using the uploaded BRAND REFERENCE (yellow/charcoal geometric A energy monogram). These are screenshots from the actual current app, not wireframes. Create production-oriented MOBILE Android color/theme redesigns of the Dashboard/Painel, Profiles/Perfis, and Battery/power detail views. Preserve the existing functionality, Portuguese labels, all actual visible data, scrollable content, and the four bottom navigation destinations Painel, Perfis, Scripts, Agenda. Do not invent hardware readings or add unsupported features. Keep the existing native Material architecture and content ordering; focus on COLOR LANGUAGE, hierarchy, buttons, active profile badges, battery rings, navigation selection and surfaces, rather than major information-architecture changes.
The dominant identity is ELECTRIC YELLOW #FFD600 and CHARCOAL #171A1F, with warm white #F7F6F0. In dark mode use neutral charcoal background, raised neutral graphite surfaces, white text, muted neutral-gray labels, crisp yellow accents for energy and selected elements. Eliminate green-tinted backgrounds and teal branding. A restrained semantic green may indicate confirmed successful/running status, and red should indicate errors/destructive actions. Selected nav can have a SOLID YELLOW pill with CHARCOAL icon and label. Use yellow filled primary actions with charcoal text, muted outlined secondary actions, and subdued yellow-tinted containers for active profile states. Maintain comfortable contrast, clear disabled states, and touch targets. Do not use yellow body text on white backgrounds.
Return the three matching dark mobile screen redesigns and, if possible, a corresponding LIGHT dashboard color version (warm-white background, white cards, charcoal body text; yellow buttons/indicators with charcoal foreground). Provide an explicit reusable palette/table for both day and night: background, surface, surface_variant, primary fill, primary text/link color, on_primary, text_primary, text_secondary, accent_container, on_accent_container, outline, success, error. Day links/outlined text should use a dark amber that meets 4.5:1 on white; electric yellow should remain the filled control color in BOTH themes. Separate those roles clearly. Export HTML/CSS with explicit HEX colors so they can be mapped back to Android resources. Use the provided ACCA-NG logo, not a new logo. No gradients or illustrations. This is a native charging utility, so the visual result should feel precise, calm, readable, and energetic.
